chunks: They say: 'Become Jews or become Christians, and find the right way.' Say: 'No. We follow the way of Abraham the upright, who was not an idolater.'

key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: Idolaters/Those who associate partners with God
key_terms.حَنِيفًا: Upright/Monotheist (one who turns away from polytheism)

ai.seo_question: What is the true religion according to the Quran in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the primacy of *millat Ibrahim* as the original, uncorrupted monotheism that predates the specific legal codes of Judaism and Christianity. It highlights Prophet Ibrahim (AS) as the archetype of the *hanif*—one who turns away from idolatry toward pure Tawhid—serving as a spiritual ancestor to all true believers, including the Ahl al-Bayt. This counters sectarian claims of exclusivity by framing Islam not as a new religion, but as the restoration of the primordial faith.
